Callout.Name: Convoy Stop - Suspected Load
Callout.Message: Two-vehicle convoy believed to be carrying narcotics.
Callout.Advisory: Both vehicles travelling together, rear plate not readable.

Script.Line: We are travelling together. That is not a crime.
The plate fell off on the highway. You can see where it was.
There is nothing in the back of either vehicle.

Lines.Approach: Two vehicles running together and the rear plate is unreadable. Stop the front one and the back one stops too.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
